meta.label: Shared Cerebras API key
meta.description: One admin-managed Cerebras key, used by everyone on the connection. Create a key at https://cloud.cerebras.ai.

params.name: api_key
params.label: Shared Cerebras API key
params.description: Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Stored encrypted; end users of the connection never see it. Grant preset access only to the intended users or groups, and create separate presets to bill or rate-limit teams independently.
